verdict.rationale: Docs describe browser actions (click/wait/scroll) and an auth flow that explicitly requires the *user* to complete a claim step in their own browser (context-dev-docs-19), not an agent bypassing CAPTCHA/login automatically. No documentation or community evidence describes automated CAPTCHA solving or credential-based login bypass, and community comments note the absence of any IP-rotation/residential-proxy infrastructure typically needed for anti-bot evasion (context-dev-comm-2, context-dev-comm-5).
